```{.quiz-yaml}
id: 14_anova_t_and_f
title: >
  Why F = t squared
questions:
  - id: why_f_t_squared
    type: free-response
    prompt: >
      Why does $F = t^2$ when ANOVA compares only two groups?
    answer: >
      Both tests quantify the same treatment effect relative to chance variability.
      ANOVA works with variances, so the corresponding value is squared relative to
      t.
    explanation: >
      With two groups, the independent-samples t test and one-way ANOVA are
      mathematically equivalent.
```
